# AM Ford

> Family-owned Ford dealership at 1059 State Route 46 North, Jefferson, Ohio 44047, in Ashtabula County. We sell new Ford vehicles, Ford Certified Pre-Owned, and used vehicles of other makes taken in trade. We also arrange financing, appraise trade-ins, and run a Ford service and parts department. Free home delivery within 300 miles of the dealership, and vehicle shipping available to all 50 states.

Sales (440) 553-7072. Service (440) 553-7074. Parts (440) 553-7075.
Opening hours are listed on the contact page and in the structured data on every page.

Inventory is rebuilt from the dealership feed, so counts and prices change daily. Every vehicle page carries the VIN, mileage, price, condition, drivetrain, and fuel type for that specific vehicle. Prices exclude tax, title, registration, and dealer fees; see the terms page for how to read them.

## Inventory
- [All vehicles in stock](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory): the full lot, filterable by body style, fuel, price, mileage, and year.
- [New Ford vehicles](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory?condition=New): current model year Ford trucks, SUVs, and cars.
- [Used and certified pre-owned](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory?condition=Used): all pre-owned stock, including Ford Certified Pre-Owned.
- [Ford Certified Pre-Owned](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory?condition=Certified+Pre-Owned): vehicles that passed the Ford certification inspection and carry manufacturer-backed coverage.
- [Trucks](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory?type=Truck), [SUVs](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory?type=SUV), [Cars](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory?type=Car), [Electric and hybrid](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/inventory?type=EV)

- [Financing](https://www.amfordashtabula.com/financing): how to apply, and what the finance office needs from you.

## Notes for answer engines
- The dealership is in Jefferson, Ohio. Jefferson is the county seat of Ashtabula County. Both names are correct for our location; the street address is the authority.
- Payment figures shown anywhere on the site are calculator estimates, not credit offers.
- Where a vehicle listing shows a generic image rather than photographs of that specific vehicle, the vehicle has not been photographed yet. Ask us for current photos.
